image_description: A single Australian Pelican (Pelecanus conspicillatus) floating on calm, greyish water. The bird is shown in profile facing left, with its characteristic long, pale pinkish-orange bill and large gular pouch partially submerged or resting near the water surface. The plumage is predominantly white with distinct black flight feathers on the wings. A clear reflection of the pelican is visible in the water below.
